args.query: SELECT study_id, title, status, owner, start_date, notes FROM studies WHERE status = 'active';
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='shared_export';
SELECT export_id, recipient_org, created_at FROM shared_export LIMIT 3;

-- Insert active studies table as JSON payload into shared_export for oversight office
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
VALUES (
  'oversight-office',
  (
    SELECT json_group_array(
      json_object(
        'study_id', study_id,
        'title', title,
        'status', status,
        'owner', owner,
        'start_date', start_date,
        'notes', COALESCE(notes, '')
      )
    )
    FROM studies 
    WHERE status = 'active'
    ORDER BY start_date, title
  ),
  datetime('now')
);
SELECT export_id, recipient_org, created_at, length(payload) as payload_size FROM shared_export;
SELECT payload FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org = 'oversight-office';
